correctness.rationale: For any reversible edge-flow matrix F on K_{p,q}, total T≤a, the bipartition cut contrast Rayleigh quotient is 1−T/(ab). Compression to the q−1 zero-sum subspace of larger-mass part has average 1−T/b, hence SLEM ≥max(1−T/b,|1−T/(ab)|). Uniform F_ij=T/(pq) exactly attains bound: eigenvalues 1, 1−T/a (p−1), 1−T/b (q−1), 1−T/(ab). Scalar minimax uniquely gives T*=a for a≤1/3 or 2ab/(1+a) for a≥1/3. Equality of the W_B average with spectral maximum makes every vector W_B an eigenvector, forcing rowwise equal F; when T*=a row capacities force equal row sums, and when T*<a the negative cut eigenvector forces equal row sums. Therefore unique kernel even without symmetry assumptions; MH T=a optimal iff a≤1/3. Independent rational and numerical eigenvalue checks corroborate.
